The '''Komnor system''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] that had previously been the home to a large clan of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a vicious warlord arrived in the system and evicted the Hutts from their home. The homeless Hutts complained to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who assigned [[Dyyz Nataz]] with the job of [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the warlord.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|224|Komnor system}}</ref>
